name: Perplexity
description: An AI-powered answer engine focused on real-time web research with cited sources, providing direct answers to questions by searching the internet and synthesizing information from multiple sources with inline citations.

writing-chat.summary: Perplexity provides conversational question-answering with a focus on factual, cited responses rather than creative writing. It functions as an answer engine rather than a traditional chatbot, with follow-up questions and source-backed responses.

subFeatures.name: Answer Engine
subFeatures.description: Provides direct, concise answers to questions with inline citations from web sources, optimized for information retrieval over open-ended conversation

subFeatures.name: Follow-Up Questions
subFeatures.description: Maintains conversation context for multi-turn follow-up questions that drill deeper into a research topic

subFeatures.name: Model Selection
subFeatures.description: Pro/Max users can select from frontier models in the model picker, including GPT-5.x, Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Perplexity's own Sonar models

subFeatures.name: Focus Modes
subFeatures.description: Filter searches by source type: All, Academic, Writing, Wolfram Alpha, YouTube, or Reddit for targeted answers

limitations: Not designed for creative writing, brainstorming, or open-ended conversation
Responses optimized for brevity and factuality over depth
Free tier limited in daily Pro Search uses
Writing mode is basic compared to ChatGPT Canvas or Claude Artifacts

pricingTiers.details: Basic search with limited Pro Search queries per day; Sonar default model
Unlimited Pro Search, model picker (GPT-5.x, Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro), file uploads, higher limits
Top frontier models (o3-pro-class, Opus-class agent), unlimited everything, priority access
SSO/SCIM, SOC 2, 500 Deep Research queries/seat/day
Unlimited everything plus org analytics

versionHistory.changes: Picker includes GPT-5.x, Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Sonar
Enhanced multi-step search with deeper source analysis
Initial answer engine with real-time web search and citations

research.summary: Research is Perplexity's core strength. Every response is grounded in real-time web search with inline numbered citations, Pro Search performs multi-step investigation, and Pages enables publishing research as shareable articles.

subFeatures.name: Real-Time Web Search
subFeatures.description: Every query triggers a live web search, synthesizing information from multiple current sources with numbered inline citations

subFeatures.name: Pro Search
subFeatures.description: Multi-step search that asks clarifying questions, searches multiple queries, and synthesizes a comprehensive answer from deeper source analysis

subFeatures.name: Academic Search
subFeatures.description: Focus mode that searches academic papers and scholarly sources, citing specific studies with DOIs and publication details

subFeatures.name: Pages
subFeatures.description: Convert research threads into polished, shareable articles with organized sections, citations, and a clean reading format

subFeatures.name: Deep Research Deliverables
subFeatures.description: Deep Research and Pro Search can emit structured outputs directly — PowerPoint, spreadsheet, dashboard, or website — via Labs

subFeatures.name: Source Transparency
subFeatures.description: Every claim is linked to its source with numbered citations, allowing users to verify information by clicking through to original articles

limitations: Cannot access paywalled academic papers (only abstracts and metadata)
Search results biased toward well-indexed English-language sources
Pro Search limited to a set number of daily queries on free tier
Labs deliverables capped on Pro (~50 queries/mo); unlimited on Max
Academic search relies on available open-access and indexed papers

pricingTiers.details: Basic web search with citations, limited Pro Search (~5/day) and Deep Research (~5/day)
Unlimited Pro Search, ~20 Deep Research/day, Academic focus, Pages, Labs (~50/mo)
Unlimited Pro Search, Deep Research and Labs; Perplexity Computer multi-model orchestration
500 Deep Research queries/seat/day with SSO/SCIM and SOC 2

versionHistory.changes: Structured outputs (PPTX, spreadsheet, dashboard, website) emitted directly
Agentic system orchestrating 19 models for complex multi-hour workflows (Max)
Convert research threads into shareable articles
Multi-step deep research with clarifying questions

file-analysis.summary: Perplexity supports file uploads for analysis on all tiers — including PDFs, images, and documents — allowing users to ask questions about uploaded content and cross-reference with web search results. Free tier gets ~40 MB/file, ~10 files/prompt, ~30-day retention.

subFeatures.name: PDF Analysis
subFeatures.description: Upload PDF documents and ask questions about their content, with Perplexity extracting and analyzing text and tables

subFeatures.name: Image Analysis
subFeatures.description: Upload images for visual question answering, identifying objects, reading text, and analyzing visual content

subFeatures.name: Document Q&A
subFeatures.description: Ask specific questions about uploaded documents and receive answers with references to specific sections

limitations: Free tier capped at ~40 MB/file, ~10 files/prompt, ~30-day retention; paid tiers raise these limits
Cannot process video or audio files
No code execution environment for data analysis

pricingTiers.details: PDF, image, and document uploads (~40 MB/file, ~10 files/prompt)
Higher file upload limits and Spaces file library (50 files/Space)
Highest file upload and retention limits

versionHistory.changes: File upload (PDF/image/document) available on all tiers, no longer Pro-gated
PDF, image, and document upload support introduced

document-creation.summary: Perplexity creates documents through Pages (shareable research articles) and Labs, a full document-to-deliverable pipeline that produces presentations (PPTX), spreadsheets (CSV), dashboards, and web apps.

subFeatures.name: Labs
subFeatures.description: Document-to-deliverable pipeline that generates PPTX presentations, CSV spreadsheets, dashboards, and web apps from a prompt or research thread

subFeatures.name: Pages
subFeatures.description: Convert research conversations into formatted, shareable articles with sections, headers, and maintained citations that can be published with a public URL

subFeatures.name: Formatted Responses
subFeatures.description: Responses include markdown formatting with headers, bullet points, numbered lists, and code blocks

limitations: Pages and Labs limited to Pro/Max subscribers
Labs has a monthly query cap on Pro (~50); unlimited on Max
No collaborative real-time document editing
Limited formatting control compared to dedicated document editors

pricingTiers.details: Formatted chat responses only
Pages plus Labs (~50 queries/mo) for PPTX, CSV, dashboards, web apps
Unlimited Labs deliverables

versionHistory.changes: Full document-to-deliverable pipeline (PPTX, CSV, dashboards, web apps)
Shareable research article creation from conversation threads

image-generation.summary: Perplexity includes image generation with a broad palette of models — GPT Image 1, FLUX.1, DALL-E 3, Google Nano Banana, Seedream 4.0, and Playground — though it remains a secondary feature rather than the platform's core focus.

subFeatures.name: AI Image Generation
subFeatures.description: Generate images from text prompts using a choice of integrated models including GPT Image 1, FLUX.1, DALL-E 3, Google Nano Banana, Seedream 4.0, and Playground

limitations: Image generation is a supplementary feature, not a core focus
Quality and control inferior to dedicated image generation tools
Limited image editing or refinement capabilities
Video generation capped (3/mo on Pro, 15/mo on Enterprise Max)

pricingTiers.details: No image generation
Image generation with model choice; 3 video generations/mo
Image generation plus 15 video generations/mo

versionHistory.changes: Image options include GPT Image 1, FLUX.1, DALL-E 3, Nano Banana, Seedream 4.0, Playground
DALL-E and Playground image generation introduced

prototyping.summary: Perplexity does not support code prototyping or interactive development. It is an answer engine focused on research, not a development environment. Users seeking code prototyping should use ChatGPT, Claude, or dedicated IDEs.

subFeatures.name: Code Display Only
subFeatures.description: Perplexity can display code snippets from web sources in responses but cannot execute, preview, or interactively edit code

limitations: No code execution environment
No live preview for any language
No interactive code editing workspace
Not designed for software development workflows

pricingTiers.details: No prototyping capabilities on any tier

versionHistory.changes: No prototyping features have been released

personalization.summary: Perplexity offers personalization through profile settings plus Memory — cross-conversation memory (upgraded to ~95% recall in February 2026) that carries context and preferences across sessions for Pro/Max users.

subFeatures.name: Memory
subFeatures.description: Cross-conversation memory that retains context and preferences across sessions; launched at ~77% recall and upgraded to ~95% recall in February 2026

subFeatures.name: User Profile
subFeatures.description: Set profession, interests, and preferred output language to influence how Perplexity tailors responses to your background

subFeatures.name: Output Language Preference
subFeatures.description: Configure preferred language for responses, independent of the language used in the query

limitations: Full cross-conversation Memory is limited to Pro/Max subscribers
No custom system prompts or detailed behavior configuration
No equivalent to Custom GPTs or Claude Projects for specialized personas
Profile settings limited to basic demographic and preference information

pricingTiers.details: Basic profile settings
Profile settings plus full cross-conversation Memory
Profile settings plus full cross-conversation Memory

versionHistory.changes: Cross-conversation memory upgraded from ~77% to ~95% recall
Basic user profile settings for response personalization

persistent-context.summary: Perplexity provides persistent context through Spaces (formerly Collections) — organized workspaces for grouping related searches with shared instructions and curated sources for ongoing research projects.

subFeatures.name: Spaces
subFeatures.description: Organized workspaces that group related search threads with custom instructions, preferred AI models, and curated source lists (50 files/Space) for focused research

subFeatures.name: Memory
subFeatures.description: Cross-conversation memory that carries context across threads, upgraded to ~95% recall in February 2026

subFeatures.name: Search History
subFeatures.description: All previous searches saved and searchable for revisiting past research threads

subFeatures.name: Thread Continuity
subFeatures.description: Follow-up questions within a thread maintain full context from the original search and subsequent queries

limitations: Spaces and full Memory require Pro/Max subscription
Spaces have limited storage for custom source files (50 files/Space)
No team-shared Spaces for collaborative research on consumer tiers

pricingTiers.details: Search history and thread continuity only
Spaces (50 files/Space) plus cross-conversation Memory
Spaces and Memory with highest limits

versionHistory.changes: Cross-conversation memory upgraded from ~77% to ~95% recall
Organized research workspaces with custom instructions and curated sources

agents.summary: Perplexity offers agentic capabilities through Comet (its Chromium-based AI browser whose Comet Assistant takes actions across open tabs) and Perplexity Computer, a Max-tier multi-model orchestration system that executes complex, multi-hour workflows.

subFeatures.name: Comet Browsing Agent
subFeatures.description: Comet Assistant inside Perplexity's AI browser navigates pages, summarizes, fills forms, and completes web tasks; free for all Perplexity account holders

subFeatures.name: Perplexity Computer
subFeatures.description: Agentic system that orchestrates 19 models in parallel to execute complex, multi-hour workflows; being extended to Pro/Enterprise

subFeatures.name: Background Assistants
subFeatures.description: Parallel/async agents that work off a to-do list in the background within Comet

subFeatures.name: Pro Search
subFeatures.description: Multi-step search process that autonomously refines queries and synthesizes results from deeper source analysis

limitations: Perplexity Computer and Background Assistants are Max-only (Computer being extended to Pro/Enterprise)
Comet Assistant actions are bounded by browser permissions and site defenses
Pro Search itself is information retrieval, not action-taking

pricingTiers.details: Comet browsing agent (Comet Assistant)
Comet agent plus unlimited Pro Search
Perplexity Computer (10k credits/mo), Background Assistants, Opus-class agent

versionHistory.changes: Multi-model agentic orchestration (19 models) for long-horizon tasks (Max)
Comet AI browser with browsing agent made free for all account holders worldwide

connectors.summary: Perplexity connects to external tools through Spaces connectors. Pro adds Gmail, Google Calendar, Notion, and GitHub; Enterprise adds Outlook, Linear, Slack, Google Drive, SharePoint, OneDrive, Dropbox, and Box.

subFeatures.name: Pro Connectors
subFeatures.description: Connect Gmail, Google Calendar, Notion, and GitHub to Spaces so Perplexity can search and reason over your data alongside the web

subFeatures.name: Enterprise Connectors
subFeatures.description: Adds Outlook, Linear, Slack, Google Drive, SharePoint, OneDrive, Dropbox, and Box for organization-wide knowledge access

limitations: Connectors require a Pro subscription or higher
Broader connector set (Slack, Outlook, Drive, etc.) requires Enterprise
Connector data access governed by each provider's permissions

pricingTiers.details: Web search only; no third-party connectors
Gmail, Google Calendar, Notion, GitHub connectors
Adds Outlook, Linear, Slack, Google Drive, SharePoint, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box

versionHistory.changes: Pro connectors (Gmail/Calendar/Notion/GitHub) and expanded Enterprise connectors available

dictation.summary: Perplexity supports voice input via mobile dictation (mic in the search box) and a full Voice Mode that holds a spoken back-and-forth with live, cited web results on screen.

subFeatures.name: Mobile Voice Dictation
subFeatures.description: Tap the microphone in the search box on mobile to dictate queries with built-in speech-to-text

subFeatures.name: Voice Mode
subFeatures.description: Rich spoken back-and-forth with live web results displayed on screen; iOS-first with Android/desktop rolling out

limitations: Voice Mode is iOS-first; Android and desktop support is still rolling out
Voice input quality depends on the device microphone and environment

pricingTiers.details: Mobile voice dictation and Voice Mode
Voice Mode with Pro features

versionHistory.changes: Spoken back-and-forth with live cited web results (iOS-first, Android/desktop rolling out)
